## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND point to lower fear, while credit stress (HYG/LQD) is rising (HYG (1W: +0.00% | 1M: +0.58%) NEUTRAL; LQD (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND), keeping the picture mixed.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ratio (level 0.7418, 1W: +0.92% | 1M: +1.07%) ↑ rising. Fear decreasing: VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Stocks vs bonds showing mild risk tilt: SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Dollar firm: Dollar Strength (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +1.21%) → flat | ABOVE TREND. Long rates pushing bonds lower: TLT (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -0.40%) BELOW TREND; yield curve flattening (Yield Curve level 1.0316 ↓ falling).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leading but narrow: XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND. Financials steady: XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing tactical strength: XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY. Style: mixed leadership given 4/11 breadth — no clear market-wide leader.

5. US vs Global?  
US showing relative strength: SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND. EM/Asia mixed: EEM (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.17%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: +4.92% | 1M: -2.76%) RECOVERY. Europe lagging vs US (Europe vs US ↓ falling).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Mixed/speculative flows: IBIT (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.10%) ABOVE TREND shows crypto ETF strength, while ARKK (1W: -1.24% | 1M: +6.99%) CORRECTION and IWM (1W: -0.53% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION show profit-taking in small cap/spec names.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Agro strength and selective reflation: WEAT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND and DBA (1W: +3.85% | 1M: +5.67%) ABOVE TREND. Gold under pressure: GLD (1W: -0.30% | 1M: -3.52%) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy rally but not uniform: BNO (1W: +6.25% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY and XLE (1W: +3.49% | 1M: -3.33%) RECOVERY, while natural gas UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Core large-cap risk tilt — SPY (ABOVE TREND) and XLK (ABOVE TREND) both 1W/1M positive. Divergence: many small-cap/thematic names show 1W weakness vs 1M gains (IWM, ARKK, XBI) → MINOR divergence; no MAJOR divergence across core ETFs.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor selective exposure to large-cap growth and stable financials (SPY (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +2.69%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak commodities and small-cap volatility (UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND; IWM (1W: -0.53% | 1M: +4.10%) CORRECTION). Monitor HYG/LQD and VXX for regime shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: Materials/Industrials under pressure; monitor XME (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -10.63%) BELOW TREND and TAN (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -11.11%) BELOW TREND for weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: WEAT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +5.99%) ABOVE TREND; BNO (1W: +6.25% | 1M: -16.47%) RECOVERY.  
BEARISH: UNG (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -6.94%) BELOW TREND; SLV (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -8.57%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -16.05%) BELOW TREND — watch ~20 for complacency. HYG/LQD ratio ~0.7418 (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +1.07%) ↑ rising — watch credit spread direction. XLK/XLF ratio 3.3348 (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -1.62%) RECOVERY — watch for sector rotation pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive.  
Tech and Financials showing relative strength (XLK (1W: +2.87% | 1M: +2.89%) ABOVE TREND; XLF (1W: +0.16% | 1M: +6.57%) ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: rising credit stress (HYG/LQD) alongside narrow breadth and small-cap/thematic divergences to monitor.
